name: Suzuki GSX-R1100
engine: 1052 to 1074 cc oil-cooled (later liquid-cooled) inline four, four carbs
intro: The big early GSX-R. Oil-cooled until 1992, then water-cooled. Four carbs either way.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.
E: Oil-cooled GSX-Rs depend on the oil to cool the engine. Use the oil spec in the manual and check the cooler lines for leaks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

forums.name: GSXR.com
